title: Return to Sender
description: SwiftCargo never sends a real email — every outbound message lands in a viewable mock outbox instead, like Mailhog. Book a shipment and confirm a confirmation email actually landed for that customer.
successCondition: After booking a shipment as a customer, GET /api/notifications/outbox?to=<customer email> (as admin) eventually includes a message with channel "email" and subject "Shipment booked".
hints: The outbox endpoint is admin-only — book the shipment as a customer, then switch to an admin session to read the outbox.
Delivery is asynchronous (see notifications-heavy-slow-boat) — you may need to wait briefly or poll.
